summary.prose: Building this Story changes two files in the code-review task-review module: the attempt header gains an optional identity-format field, and the attribution binding learns a second task identity format that ignores test-row provenance, carries a provenance digest for accurate rejection text, and reports every refused reuse task in one rejection. The work lands in three steps, header first, then the identity, then the format-aware bind, each with tests in a new reuse-identity test file; existing reuse tests must keep passing unchanged.

tasks.title: Record the task identity format on the attempt header
tasks.summary: Add the optional taskIdentityFormat: 'final-task-v2' field to the attempt header interface and its strict schema in src/workflow/code-review/task-review/contracts.ts, export the TaskIdentityFormat type, and extend validateSavedAttribution so the field must be absent on unpinned, pending and failed attempts.
acceptanceChecks: A header with taskIdentityFormat 'final-task-v2' passes the strict schema; any other value is refused.
An unpinned, pending or failed attempt carrying taskIdentityFormat is refused with the existing messages.
Saved attempts without the field validate exactly as before.

tests.name: src/workflow/code-review/task-review/__tests__/reuse-identity.test.ts: the attempt header schema accepts only the v2 identity format
src/workflow/code-review/task-review/__tests__/reuse-identity.test.ts: an identity format on an unaccepted attempt is refused

tasks.title: Add the v2 task identity and a provenance-aware fingerprint
tasks.summary: Give taskFinalInput and taskFinalIdentity an optional format: 'final-task-v1' (default) stays byte-identical; 'final-task-v2' hashes each test as { file, cases, result, blobOid }. Fingerprint test entries carry identity (v2 digest) and provenance (whole-row digest), and reuseMismatch takes the comparison format and compares provenance only under v1. Until t3, requireReuseIdentity passes 'final-task-v1' so behaviour is unchanged.
acceptanceChecks: v1 identities equal the constants pinned from the pre-change code.
v2 identity ignores command, executionDetails and evidenceReferences and changes with test file blob, cases (including order) and result.
A task with no tests has a v2 identity over requirements, changes and documents.
Under v1 the rejection text names a provenance-only test change; under v2 it does not.
After t2 alone, existing reuse behaviour and rejection text are unchanged.

src/workflow/code-review/task-review/__tests__/reuse-identity.test.ts: the rejection names a provenance-only change between two v1 attempts

tasks.title: Bind in the attempt's format and report all reuse refusals at once
tasks.summary: bindTaskFinalIdentities resolves its format (header field, else v1 for accepted, v2 for pending), records taskIdentityFormat on a newly accepted candidate, and passes the format to the reuse check. requireReuseIdentity gains the optional format parameter and refuses a cross-format source. Source checks still throw at once; format and identity refusals are collected and raised as one TaskReviewInputError (single refusal unchanged).
acceptanceChecks: Provenance-only edits keep reuse of a v2 source, for one task and for three tasks in one submission.
A real test change still refuses reuse with the existing reassess text.
Three tasks whose source is v1 are refused in one rejection naming all three, costing one attribution submission.
Malformed reuse decisions (not earlier, foreign-party) still fail at once with the existing origins error.
Saved v1 attempts, including a v1 attempt that reused a v1 attempt, re-bind unchanged.
A published v2 reuse row passes validateTaskBody's reuse-identity check.
Existing attribution-binding and compatibility tests pass unchanged.
